title: The Harness Feature in Agent Framework

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to make a review of the harness features that have just been released in Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 今天要評測 Agent Framework 剛推出的 Harness 功能。

cues.en: So let's get into a little about what it is and then see some code.
cues.zh: 先介紹它是什麼，再看看程式碼。

cues.en: So what is an agent harness?
cues.zh: 什麼是 Agent Harness 呢？

cues.en: A harness is just a fancy word for taking an LLM model and putting instructions and tools on top of them.
cues.zh: Harness 只是比較花俏的說法，指的是在 LLM 模型外面加上指示與工具。

cues.en: And especially an agent harness, you might know them from things like GitHub Copilot CLI.
cues.zh: 你可能已經透過 GitHub Copilot CLI 等工具接觸過 Agent Harness。

cues.en: This is actually an agent harness where you have some instructions, meaning the system information on you need to write code, and you have some tools for reading files,
cues.zh: 它就是一種 Harness：有撰寫程式碼的系統指示，還有讀取檔案，

cues.en: writing files, finding files, and so on.
cues.zh: 寫入檔案、尋找檔案等工具。

cues.en: And similarly, you could choose codecs, or you could use the GitHub Copilot inside Visual Studio Code.
cues.zh: 同樣地，也可以使用 Codex，或 Visual Studio Code 裡的 GitHub Copilot。

cues.en: Cloud Code is an agent harness.
cues.zh: Claude Code 也是一種 Agent Harness。

cues.en: And this is what the Agent Framework team have put into their system.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 團隊現在把這類功能加入框架中了。

cues.en: So let's talk a little about the code and the three samples they have.
cues.zh: 接著介紹程式碼，以及官方提供的三個範例。

cues.en: Because I'm going to use their samples, because this is a lot of code, and I'm also a bit unsure why we need this sample in the first place.
cues.zh: 我會直接使用官方範例，因為程式碼非常多，而且我也不太確定為什麼框架需要這類範例。

cues.en: But let's talk a little about the code first.
cues.zh: 不過先看看程式碼。

cues.en: So inside, we can go in here, inside the Microsoft Agent Framework's own code, they also have a bunch of samples.
cues.zh: Microsoft Agent Framework 自己的原始碼裡，也有很多範例。

cues.en: So this is the thing that I'm looking at right now.
cues.zh: 現在看的就是這個位置。

cues.en: So they have three samples, they have a research sample, they have some research with sub-agents that goes in and do some stock analysis,
cues.zh: 這裡有三個範例：一般研究、有子代理程式的研究，會用來分析股票，

cues.en: and some data processing of some sales data.
cues.zh: 以及針對銷售資料進行資料處理。

cues.en: So an open agent tool, and then two other tools.
cues.zh: 也就是一個研究代理程式，再加上另外兩個範例。

cues.en: The second tool uses sub-agents.
cues.zh: 第二個會使用子代理程式。

cues.en: And besides those three, there's a bunch of extra code up here.
cues.zh: 除了這三個範例，上方還有很多額外程式碼。

cues.en: And I mean a bunch, because inside these three is what is needed in order to build something like GitHub Copilot.
cues.zh: 而且真的很多，因為裡面包含建立類似 GitHub Copilot 所需的所有部分。

cues.en: Not as fancy, but of course it's just a sample.
cues.zh: 當然沒那麼精緻，畢竟只是範例。

cues.en: But there's over 4,000 lines of code up here.
cues.zh: 不過上方就有超過四千行程式碼。

cues.en: And I don't want to take and recreate that, so that's the reason why I'm going with their sample instead.
cues.zh: 我不想重新複製並實作，所以直接使用官方範例。

cues.en: Besides the sample data, which is the bulk of all this, there is some new things down in the Microsoft Agents.ai package,
cues.zh: 除了占了大部分篇幅的範例程式外，Microsoft.Agents.AI 套件裡也新增了一些內容，

cues.en: which is under a Harness namespace, where there's a bunch of new AI context providers.
cues.zh: 放在 Harness 命名空間，包含一組新的 AI Context Provider，

cues.en: And a little middleware.
cues.zh: 以及少量中介軟體。

cues.en: So there's things for setting an agent mode, plan mode, or execution mode, like you might know in coding agents.
cues.zh: 例如可設定代理程式模式，包括規劃模式與執行模式，就像程式開發代理程式。

cues.en: There are some tools for file access, there's tools for memory and for storage of files.
cues.zh: 另外有檔案存取工具、記憶工具，以及檔案儲存功能。

cues.en: There's spinning up sub-agents.
cues.zh: 也能啟動子代理程式。

cues.en: There's a to-do item, just like you see in GitHub Copilot, where it makes a, now I need to do this, now I need to do this.
cues.zh: 還有待辦清單功能，像 GitHub Copilot 會列出接下來要做的事情。

cues.en: And then there's a tool for, hey, approve this tool, and don't ask me again, system.
cues.zh: 再來是工具核准機制，支援允許這個工具、以後不要再詢問。

cues.en: And then there's a new NuGet package itself, which is Microsoft Agents.ai Harness, where we have something called a Harness agent, and some options for that.
cues.zh: 此外也有新的 Microsoft.Agents.AI.Harness NuGet 套件，提供 HarnessAgent 與相關選項。

cues.en: And I'm finding it a bit strange that Harness is both in the raw package, and have its own package.
cues.zh: 我覺得有點奇怪，因為 Harness 功能同時出現在基礎套件與獨立套件裡。

cues.en: So I don't really understand why this code is inside here, and not in the Harness package, because that's where it belongs, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 我不太理解為什麼這些程式碼放在基礎套件，而不是 Harness 套件；我認為應該放在後者。

cues.en: But I'm not having the insight into what this is about.
cues.zh: 不過我也不了解團隊的完整考量。

cues.en: But let's go in and see this.
cues.zh: 我們實際來看看。

cues.en: Because if we look into the research sample, which is the first one,
cues.zh: 先看第一個研究範例，

cues.en: what we can see is that we use just normal Azure OpenAI, and we use a model like always.
cues.zh: 可以看到它和往常一樣，使用一般 Azure OpenAI 與指定的模型。

cues.en: And then we go in and set some token limits, because it can actually do quite a lot of tokens, and has long-running background work.
cues.zh: 接著設定一些 Token 上限，因為這類工作可能耗費很多 Token，也可能在背景長時間執行。

cues.en: And then a bunch of instructions on how to do plan mode, how to do execution mode.
cues.zh: 然後是一大段規劃模式與執行模式的指示。

cues.en: I'll let you see this on your own.
cues.zh: 這些細節可以自行閱讀。

cues.en: And then we make an agent, and we'll just use OpenAI client against Azure.
cues.zh: 接著建立代理程式，使用 OpenAI 用戶端連接 Azure。

cues.en: And we're going to use the responses client, and then we use the special one as AI chat client without stored output.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Responses Client，再轉成不儲存輸出的 AI Chat Client。

cues.en: This turns off that it's storing the conversations up in Azure OpenAI,
cues.zh: 這會停用 Azure OpenAI 雲端的對話儲存，

cues.en: and instead just keep it in memory.
cues.zh: 改成只保留在記憶體。

cues.en: And then it has this new asHarnessAgent.
cues.zh: 然後使用新的 AsHarnessAgent。

cues.en: And that might look like a fancy extra thing, but it's actually not too much what's happening inside this one.
cues.zh: 它看起來像是很厲害的新功能，但內部其實沒有太多處理。

cues.en: The only thing it really does is that it sets up the default compaction.
cues.zh: 主要只是設定預設的壓縮機制。

cues.en: So it's essentially a chat reducer that's built in.
cues.zh: 基本上就是內建的對話縮減器。

cues.en: It sets up an in-memory chat history provider.
cues.zh: 另外會設定記憶體中的對話歷程提供者。

cues.en: And beyond that, it doesn't do too much.
cues.zh: 除此之外，沒有做太多事情。

cues.en: It does a little about function call invocation and message injection.
cues.zh: 還有少量函式呼叫與訊息注入的設定。

cues.en: So a bit of setup, but nothing major.
cues.zh: 也就是一些初始化，但不是很大的功能。

cues.en: You can see there's almost no code here in the agent on this.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個代理程式類別裡幾乎沒有程式碼。

cues.en: So a bit strange that it's even made, but it is.
cues.zh: 所以我有點不懂為什麼要另外建立它，但目前就是這樣。

cues.en: And that's what's part of the new package, together with the options, where you can more or less set the same thing as a normal agent.
cues.zh: 這些內容和選項屬於新的套件；能設定的東西和一般代理程式大致相同。

cues.en: So I'm a bit puzzled why they did this, but that's okay.
cues.zh: 我對這個設計有點困惑，不過沒關係。

cues.en: And then in this case, we add a to-do provider.
cues.zh: 這個範例接著加入待辦事項提供者。

cues.en: So a to-do provider is just a set of tools for adding and removing and getting remaining to-dos and keeping track of those to-dos.
cues.zh: 它其實就是一組工具，用來新增、刪除、取得未完成的待辦事項，並追蹤它們。

cues.en: So we could have quite easily made this ourselves with various tools and stuff, the modes for plan or execute,
cues.zh: 所以透過各種工具，我們其實也能輕鬆自己建立，包含規劃或執行模式，

cues.en: and some memory system that saves some memory down into the system.
cues.zh: 以及把記憶儲存到檔案中的系統。

cues.en: Then it gives access to a web search tool and a self-built search tool that just uses download UI.
cues.zh: 接著加入網頁搜尋工具，以及自製的下載網頁工具。

cues.en: Then it takes this tool approval, so it can stop asking again and again.
cues.zh: 再加入工具核准功能，避免重複詢問。

cues.en: And then it sends it into all this extra code.
cues.zh: 然後把這些設定交給那一大堆額外程式碼。

cues.en: And again, I won't go into this.
cues.zh: 這部分就不逐一介紹了。

cues.en: Again, there's 4,000 lines of code that essentially builds up a UI.
cues.zh: 那四千行程式碼，基本上是在建立使用者介面。

cues.en: And that UI, if we run it here, looks like this.
cues.zh: 實際執行後，介面會長這樣。

cues.en: So we can write slash exit, we can write slash to-dos,
cues.zh: 我們可以輸入 /exit，也可以輸入 /todos，

cues.en: and see we have no to-dos, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 查看目前沒有待辦事項，還有其他指令。

cues.en: And what we can do is we can, for example, say...
cues.zh: 例如我們可以輸入……

cues.en: So that's what topics should we research.
cues.zh: 它問我們想研究什麼主題。

cues.en: First 10 people in space.
cues.zh: 「最早進入太空的十個人」。

cues.en: And if we do this, it goes into a same mode as a copilot CLI or a codex, and begins to do various sets of work.
cues.zh: 送出後，就會像 Copilot CLI 或 Codex 一樣，開始執行一系列工作。

cues.en: So it's now calling that it needs to go into the right agent mode.
cues.zh: 現在它正在切換到適合的代理程式模式。

cues.en: It created three to-do items now, clarify the counts of people, verify 10 people, prepare concise thing,
cues.zh: 它建立了三項待辦：釐清人數的定義、查證十個人的資料、準備精簡答案，

cues.en: made a plan for that, so it used its fine memory tool.
cues.zh: 再建立計畫，使用檔案記憶工具保存。

cues.en: And now it has made that, and we are being asked a few things.
cues.zh: 完成後，它會提出幾個問題。

cues.en: Should we have it in chronological order, including suborbital flights, only orbital flights, or something?
cues.zh: 例如是否按時間排序、要包含次軌道飛行，還是只計算軌道飛行？

cues.en: Say only orbital flights.
cues.zh: 我們選擇只計算軌道飛行。

cues.en: So these are just instructions of asking for clarifying questions, and all the work around getting this UI to work.
cues.zh: 這些都是靠指示要求模型提出釐清問題，再加上周邊程式碼來支援介面。

cues.en: And it works in some places.
cues.zh: 某些地方運作得還不錯。

cues.en: Here you can see it just goes off the screen with the response, and not wrapping.
cues.zh: 但這裡可以看到，回覆超出畫面，而且沒有自動換行。

cues.en: But now asking, are we okay with this plan, and do we want to execute it?
cues.zh: 現在它問我們是否同意計畫，要不要執行。

cues.en: And let's execute it.
cues.zh: 那就執行吧。

cues.en: So now it's into execution mode, reading the plan, getting the to-do items, do a bunch of web search calls now.
cues.zh: 接著進入執行模式、讀取計畫、取得待辦事項，再發出一連串網頁搜尋呼叫。

cues.en: So most of the code is actually building this GUI.
cues.zh: 所以大部分程式碼，其實都在建構這個介面。

cues.en: And I will get a little later into why I think they built this.
cues.zh: 稍後我會說明，我認為他們為什麼做這個範例。

cues.en: But it's going through the different work, and I've seen it sometimes stall, and I need to write continue,
cues.zh: 它會逐步處理各項工作；我也看過它有時停住，需要輸入繼續，

cues.en: just like some of the coding agents as well.
cues.zh: 這點和某些程式開發代理程式一樣。

cues.en: And it tries to keep track of how many tokens it uses.
cues.zh: 它也試著追蹤已使用的 Token 數量。

cues.en: I don't think they are correct, those limits, but that's another thing.
cues.zh: 我不太確定這些計數與限制是否正確，不過那是另一回事。

cues.en: So it comes back with its answer, and who was the first in space, second in space, and so on,
cues.zh: 最後它會回答第一個、第二個進入太空的人是誰，依序列出，

cues.en: based on various sources that it found on the fly.
cues.zh: 並引用執行時搜尋到的各種來源。

cues.en: So a little like GitHub Copilot or Cloud Code.
cues.zh: 有點像 GitHub Copilot 或 Claude Code。

cues.en: The second demo is not as impressive, but let's go in and see it. So in that one,
cues.zh: 第二個範例沒那麼驚豔，不過還是看看。這裡，

cues.en: we're essentially just seeing that it adds a tool that is a web search tool.
cues.zh: 基本上只是加入一個網頁搜尋工具。

cues.en: And in a parent agent, it gets that it can have sub-agents,
cues.zh: 父代理程式則可以使用子代理程式，

cues.en: which is just a way of spawning new agents on the fly, if need be.
cues.zh: 也就是必要時動態建立新的代理程式。

cues.en: So if we start this sample, it needs to get some stock tickers,
cues.zh: 啟動這個範例後，需要輸入股票代號，

cues.en: some Microsoft, and let's take Atlassian.
cues.zh: 例如 Microsoft，再加上 Atlassian。

cues.en: It's easy to remember that it's called team.
cues.zh: Atlassian 的代號是 TEAM，很容易記。

cues.en: So now it will spin up two sub-agents, one for each of them, and do the work, finding the price,
cues.zh: 現在它會啟動兩個子代理程式，分別查詢各自的股價，

cues.en: apparently at the end of last year.
cues.zh: 看起來查的是去年年底的價格。

cues.en: I've seen this fail a few times, not getting the right data, but...
cues.zh: 我看過它好幾次沒有找到正確資料，不過……

cues.en: Again, there's all this extra code that keeps track of all the state, how far is everything in the...
cues.zh: 同樣地，那些額外程式碼會負責追蹤所有狀態，例如各工作進行到哪裡。

cues.en: So it's a big, big orchestration task, those 4,000 lines of sample code.
cues.zh: 所以那四千行範例程式，處理的是很大的工作編排問題。

cues.en: And yes, sometimes it just comes back and it couldn't do it.
cues.zh: 而且沒錯，有時候它就是回覆無法完成。

cues.en: We can say try again, and sometimes it works.
cues.zh: 可以要求再試一次，有時就會成功。

cues.en: So it spins up two new sub-agents instead, and try to figure it out.
cues.zh: 它會重新啟動兩個子代理程式，再試著查詢。

cues.en: So now it found it for one of them, but not the other.
cues.zh: 現在找到其中一個，但另一個還沒找到。

cues.en: It depends on what's going on, and it's, of course, based on how good is the instructions, how good are the tools.
cues.zh: 結果取決於當下情況，當然也和指示與工具的品質有關。

cues.en: The final sample is where there's some sales data of some various things that's been sold,
cues.zh: 最後一個範例包含銷售資料，列出賣出的各種商品，

cues.en: and who's the salesperson.
cues.zh: 以及負責銷售的人員。

cues.en: And similar to the other ones, it's just a data analysis that will now have access to various files, and being able to grab those data.
cues.zh: 和前面類似，這是一個資料分析情境，代理程式能存取各種檔案並取得資料。

cues.en: Oh, that's not the right one. So let's say,
cues.zh: 喔，選錯了。我們改問：

cues.en: what is the most sold item in quantity?
cues.zh: 「依銷售數量計算，賣得最多的是哪個商品？」

cues.en: This one I've seen throw back a lot of reasoning back, and suddenly in the middle of...
cues.zh: 這個範例有時會輸出很多推理內容，然後突然在中途，

cues.en: The sentence just stopped, but let's see if it goes better this time.
cues.zh: 一句話還沒講完就停了。看看這次會不會好一點。

cues.en: It actually went OK.
cues.zh: 這次倒是執行完成了。

cues.en: So it found that the notebook pack is the one that sold the most.
cues.zh: 它找到賣得最多的是筆記本組。

cues.en: It did it wrong.
cues.zh: 但答案錯了。

cues.en: Let's tell it that.
cues.zh: 我們告訴它。

cues.en: Yeah, OK. It's still wrong.
cues.zh: 好，它還是答錯。

cues.en: And it just goes off.
cues.zh: 接著又繼續處理。

cues.en: Again, this is not the important part.
cues.zh: 不過這不是重點。

cues.en: The important part is that there is this harness around an HTML file, an agent that's not very smart here.
cues.zh: 重點是，這裡有一個圍繞 LLM 代理程式的 Harness；這個代理程式的表現沒有特別好，

cues.en: That's another matter of opinion.
cues.zh: 不過這是另一個主觀評價。

cues.en: But that's what we have in three samples.
cues.zh: 總之，官方提供了這三個範例。

cues.en: And my big question is why.
cues.zh: 而我最大的疑問是：為什麼？

cues.en: Why in the world are we getting these demos? They're cool.
cues.zh: 為什麼需要這些示範？它們確實很酷。

cues.en: It's cool to see a bigger demo, but it's not like I can take those 4,000 lines of code and just copy over and ship it to my customer or anything.
cues.zh: 看到大型示範是件好事，但我不可能把這四千行直接複製，然後就交給客戶使用。

cues.en: Or if I do, I would be stupid and not use a tool like Codex instead, which is a dedicated tool to do it.
cues.zh: 如果真要那樣做，與其自己維護，我不如直接使用 Codex 這類專門的工具。

cues.en: I think they made this sample to show that it's possible to do.
cues.zh: 我認為官方做這些範例，是為了證明框架有這個能力。

cues.en: And I think it's made for some upcoming demo that they need to do, perhaps doing Microsoft Build in June.
cues.zh: 也可能是為了準備未來的展示，例如六月的 Microsoft Build。

cues.en: I'm recording this middle of May.
cues.zh: 我錄製這支影片時是五月中。

cues.en: I think this is there.
cues.zh: 我猜這就是目的，

cues.en: Look how cool and how advanced you can build something in Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 讓大家看看，用 Agent Framework 可以建立多麼酷、多麼進階的系統。

cues.en: because just showing a chat, just showing tools and so on, is not really any news.
cues.zh: 因為只是展示對話或工具呼叫，已經不是什麼新鮮事。

cues.en: But showing that it's actually a very, very cool feature tool that you can build around.
cues.zh: 但這能展示，框架可以支撐非常完整的進階工具。

cues.en: And I actually had this idea on my to-do list of videos as well.
cues.zh: 其實我的影片待辦清單上，也有類似的想法。

cues.en: I wanted to build a coding agent myself as well, and this is what essentially they have done.
cues.zh: 我原本也想自己建立程式開發代理程式，而他們基本上已經做了。

cues.en: And also shown that it's not that much about AI and much more about building a good GUI and building the right tools for an algorithm
cues.zh: 這也說明，重點不見得是 AI，而是建立好的介面、提供演算法需要的正確工具，

cues.en: and keeping the orchestration right.
cues.zh: 並妥善維持整個工作編排。

cues.en: And as we saw, it failed a bunch in good instructions and so on, so those demos will probably be iterated on
cues.zh: 如剛才所見，在指示等方面仍有不少失敗，所以這些示範應該會繼續調整，

cues.en: until they need to do a demo on them.
cues.zh: 直到正式展示之前。

cues.en: That's at least my thought process about this, because it's not really showing us how to use Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 至少我是這麼想的，因為它並不是真的在教我們如何使用 Agent Framework，

cues.en: not to use the various features.
cues.zh: 或個別功能的用法。

cues.en: It's just they have built a bunch of tools just like we could.
cues.zh: 主要只是他們做了一組工具，就像我們也能自己做。

cues.en: I had no doubt in my mind that it was possible to build something like GitHub Copilot using Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 我從來不懷疑，用 Agent Framework 可以建立類似 GitHub Copilot 的東西。

cues.en: Of course, it could be done, but that it's a bunch of extra code that needs to go into it.
cues.zh: 當然做得到，只是需要大量周邊程式碼。

cues.en: So again, in here, all the things that has nothing to do with the Agent Framework
cues.zh: 再看這裡，所有與 Agent Framework 本身沒有直接關係的部分，

cues.en: is 4,000 lines of code here, and then just a few lines of code down here for the various out-of-the-box tools and so on.
cues.zh: 就占了四千行；真正使用內建工具等功能的，只有下方少量程式碼。

cues.en: So I don't really feel that it fits inside a Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 所以我不太覺得這些內容適合放進 Microsoft Agent Framework 本身。

cues.en: I could see it if they just had an example and not had all of this and just kept it here, and had this kept over here.
cues.zh: 如果只是放成獨立範例，把這些程式碼留在範例裡，我比較能理解。

cues.en: But why it's inside being maintained is a bit the thing, because if you really want to do file memory,
cues.zh: 但為什麼要放進核心並持續維護？例如你真的要做檔案記憶，

cues.en: you probably don't want to do file memory.
cues.zh: 實際上可能並不想用檔案儲存記憶。

cues.en: You want to do memory in a database or a vector store or whatever.
cues.zh: 你可能想用資料庫、向量儲存區，或其他系統。

cues.en: So why this is now inside?
cues.zh: 那為什麼現在要把這個功能放進來？

cues.en: It's experimental, so they can take it away, of course, but it really puzzles me why we are seeing this.
cues.zh: 它仍是實驗性功能，當然隨時可以移除，但我確實不太明白這個方向。

cues.en: So I can't really see myself using this that much when there is dedicated tools.
cues.zh: 已有專門工具的情況下，我不覺得自己會大量使用它。

cues.en: Had Codex, Cloud Code, and all these things not existed,
cues.zh: 如果 Codex、Claude Code 等工具不存在，

cues.en: of course, it would make sense for us to build them, but they do.
cues.zh: 那我們自己建立當然合理，但這些工具確實已經存在了。

cues.en: But again, they have them.
cues.zh: 不過無論如何，官方已經提供了這些功能。

cues.en: We can try them out.
cues.zh: 我們可以拿來試用。

cues.en: If you need to build something like this, you definitely need to go in and start exactly how they did the small little details.
cues.zh: 如果真的需要建立類似系統，很值得仔細研究他們怎麼處理那些細節。

cues.en: But in normal AI that you're probably going to make with Agent Framework, this is not really something
cues.zh: 但對一般使用 Agent Framework 開發的 AI 應用而言，這並不是，

cues.en: we can use for too much, in my opinion at least.
cues.zh: 能直接派上很多用場的功能，至少我個人這麼認為。

cues.en: But if you think differently, please let me know in the comments.
cues.zh: 如果你有不同想法，也歡迎在留言告訴我。

cues.en: But that's everything for me this time.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就到這裡。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
